an7.43:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Kosambiyaṃ viharati Ghositārāme.
an7.43:1.3: Atha kho āyasmā Ānando pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram ādāya Kosambiyaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi.
an7.43:1.4: Atha kho āyasmato Ānandassa etad ahosi
an7.43:1.6: yan nūnāhaṃ yena aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ ārāmo ten' upasaṅkameyyan' ti.
an7.43:1.7: Atha kho āyasmā Ānando yena aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ ārāmo ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā tehi aññatitthiyehi paribbājakehi saddhiṃ sammodi,
an7.43:1.8: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. 2.
an7.43:2.1: Tena kho pana samayena tesaṃ aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ sannisinnānaṃ sannipatitānaṃ ayam antarākathā udapādi
an7.43:2.2: ‘yo hi koci āvuso dvādasa vassāni paripuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carati, "niddaso bhikkhū" ti alaṃ vacanāyā' ti.
an7.43:3.1: Atha kho āyasmā Ānando tesaṃ aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ bhāsitaṃ neva abhinandi na ppaṭikkosi;
an7.43:3.3: ‘Bhagavato santike etassa bhāsitassa atthaṃ ājānissāmī ti. 3.
an7.43:3.4: Atha kho āyasmā Ānando Kosambiyaṃ piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Ānando Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca
an7.43:4.1: ‘idhāhaṃ bhante pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram ādāya Kosambiyaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisiṃ.
an7.43:4.3: atippago kho tāva Kosambiyaṃ piṇḍāya carituṃ;
an7.43:4.4: yan nūnāhaṃ yena aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ ārāmo ten' upasaṅkameyyan ti. Atha khvāhaṃ bhante yena aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ ārāmo ten' upasaṅkamiṃ, upasaṅkamitvā
an7.43:4.6: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃ.
an7.43:5.1: Tena kho pana bhante samayena tesaṃ aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ sannisinnānaṃ sannipatitānaṃ ayam antarākathā udapādi:
an7.43:5.2: yo hi koci āvuso dvādasa vassāni paripuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carati, "niddaso bhikkhū" ti alaṃ vacanāyā ti.
an7.43:5.3: Atha khvāhaṃ bhante tesaṃ aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ bhāsitaṃ neva abhinandiṃ na ppaṭikkosiṃ;
an7.43:5.5: Bhagavato santike etassa bhāsitassa atthaṃ ājānissāmī ti.
an7.43:5.6: Sakkā nu kho bhante imasmiṃ dhammavinaye kevalaṃ vassagaṇanamattena niddaso bhikkhu paññāpetun' ti?
an7.43:6.1: Na kho Ānanda sakkā imasmiṃ dhammavinaye kevalaṃ vassagaṇanamattena niddaso bhikkhu paññāpetuṃ.
an7.43:6.2: Satta kho imāni Ānanda niddasavatthūni mayā sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā paveditāni.
an7.43:7.2: Idh' Ānanda bhikkhu saddho hoti, hirimā hoti, ottappī hoti, bahussuto hoti, āraddhavirayo hoti, satimā hoti, paññavā hoti.
an7.43:7.3: Imāni kho Ānanda satta niddasavatthūni mayā sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā paveditāni. 5.
an7.43:7.4: Imehi kho Ānanda sattahi niddasavatthūhi samannāgato bhikkhu dvādasa ce pi vassāni paripuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carati, "niddaso bhikkhū" ti alaṃ vacanāya,
an7.43:7.5: catuvīsati ce pi vassāni paripuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carati, "niddaso bhikkhū" ti alaṃ vacanāya,
an7.43:7.6: chattiṃsa ce pi vassāni paripuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carati, "niddaso bhikkhū" ti alaṃ vacanāya, aṭṭhacattārisañ ce pi vassāni paripuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carati, "niddaso bhikkhū" ti alaṃ vacanāyā ti.
